introduction: The Biology SBA is based on a series of practical experiments and a final project or investigative task. It contributes 20% to the final grade.

tasks.title: P&D Task
tasks.explanation: Formulate a hypothesis and design an experiment to test it.

tasks.title: ORR
tasks.explanation: Present data accurately using tables, drawings, or graphs.

tasks.title: A&I
tasks.explanation: Interpret the data and draw conclusions related to biological theories.

tasks.title: M&M
tasks.explanation: Demonstrate skillful use of lab equipment.

sampleTitle: An investigation into the effect of temperature on the rate of enzyme activity (catalase) in potato tissue.

sample.body: Hypothesis: As temperature increases from 10°C to 40°C, the rate of oxygen production (foam height) will increase, but will decrease above 40°C as the enzyme denatures.
sample.tips: Ensure the hypothesis is testable and specific.

sample.body: Potato cylinders of equal length were placed in hydrogen peroxide at different temperatures (10, 20, 30, 40, 50°C). The height of the foam produced after 2 minutes was measured using a ruler.
sample.tips: Identify controlled, independent, and dependent variables.

marking: Marks are given for accurate observations, logical deductions, and precise measurements. Scientific drawings must follow specific conventions.
